notes.title: Move 'n' Bloom - Linux version is out now!
notes.content:
What's new:

 Linux build of the game
 also a Linux build of the demo
 fixed the undo key for qwerty keyboard layout
 fixed small sprites issues in the credits view


Attention: the current Linux build was tested on Ubuntu 16.04 and 18.04.

notes.title: Move 'n' Bloom - v. 1.2.0
notes.content:
What's new:

 added auto undo, by holding the 'z' key down
 added some optional (more complex) puzzles for players who finished the game
 added one additional Achievement
 added Turkish language
 removed the limit of 18 undo's
 one of the previous hidden brocken Achievements is now achievable
 optimizations and small fixes
